As part of the overall outreach and visibility strategy and in order to foster a better understanding of European border management practices the project has initiated translation of various Frontex publications into Arabic. In addition to the VEGA handbook and the 2018 Annual Report of the AfricanIntelligence Community AFIC which were finalised and published in Year 2 four more publications have been released in Arabic and French in the course of 2021 Technical and Operational Strategy for European Integrated Border Management AR European Centre for Returns in brief AR European Cooperation on Coast Guard Functions AR and Occupational health and safety deployment information AR FR. In addition to these the translation of the Handbook on Contingency Planning and VAU training fiches AR FR was finalised and the translations of the Frontex Mental Health Strategy AR FR and the PRADO Glossary AR were initiated during the reporting period and is ongoing in view of the trainings planned in these two areas for 2022. Although the translations are performed by the Translation Centre for the Bodies of the EU CdT as mentioned earlier in the section on expert recruitment see Infra 4.1.2 the difficulty to identify Arabic speaking experts to verify substantial and linguistic quality has hampered the swift execution of these activities and caused delays. In order to foster a better understanding of EU border management concepts and practices the project has been developing a trilingual EN AR FR glossary of border management and security terminology that will become part of Interactive Terminology for Europe IATE the EUs publicly available terminology database used in the EU institutions. Thanks to the cooperation with the Translation Centre for the Bodies of the EU CdT the terms included in the glossary also in Arabic will become part of the official standardised EU terminology and should facilitate in the future the development of the language for the promotion of EU standards on border management in the external dimension and in particular in the Arabic speaking world.
